spec_match.rationale: Exercises startDiagnosticLogging({allowUpload, metadata}) exactly as the WICG draft defines it, enforces the 5-entry/100-char metadata limits in a live counter, and documents the real Chromium RangeError-vs-spec-TypeError divergence with the rtc.cc citation plus the UTF-8-byte measurement nuance — exemplary research depth.

interactive.rationale: An allowUpload checkbox, an editable metadata table with add/remove rows and live limit validation, a real start call, a finish button, and a bug-report stub auto-stamped with the returned session ID.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises allowUpload plus structured metadata, the ID handed to a bug report, the spec's limits, and the RangeError divergence; every element is on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers over-limit entry counts and over-length keys/values with live warnings that work even without the API, treats either RangeError or TypeError as proof the limit is enforced, and keeps the start button disabled with an honest note when navigator.rtc is absent.

references.rationale: Links the Chromium rtc.cc source directly but omits the https://chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376 self-heal link (present on the capability-policy-probe sibling).

conformance.rationale: The suite's metadata-entry-limit and metadata-length-limit assertions encode exactly this page's contract (accepting the documented RangeError divergence); their failure in this unflagged Chromium 141 is the expected absent surface.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial DOM shows the seeded three-entry table, honest warn status with start disabled, and the live counter; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; row editing, limit crossing, and the start/finish flow could not be driven non-interactively.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the ID-with-metadata start contract, the limit-enforced contract on rejection (RangeError/TypeError), and finish resolution.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours, proper fieldset/legend grouping, and over-limit warnings in AA-clean rose, but the default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone, ~3.5:1 at 0.8rem bold) misses WCAG AA.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend semantics, per-row aria-labels on key/value inputs and remove buttons, an aria-live limit counter, role=status status line, and a labelled checkbox.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow, but the per-row remove buttons measure ~30×30px — under the ≈44px tap-target guidance for touch — while the add-entry button is 44.6px tall; desktop 1280×800 is clean.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link to this page's see-also
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires the chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376 self-heal link on every page; this page cites rtc.cc but not the ChromeStatus entry. One-line additive fix alongside logging-lifecycle.

openQuestions.title: Enlarge the metadata remove buttons to touch-target size
openQuestions.detail: The ✕ remove buttons measure ~30×30px on the mobile viewport (guidance ≈44px). Increase their padding or hit area (e.g. min-width/min-height 2.75rem) without shrinking the inputs; measured via CDP at 360×740 DPR3.

openQuestions.title: Fix the warn status amber contrast
openQuestions.detail: The default-visible warn status is --accent-amber on --bg-stone at ~3.5:1, below AA 4.5:1 for 0.8rem bold text — the shared milestone-wide pattern; one darker token fixes all instances.

openQuestions.title: Verify the metadata limits and divergence on a flagged build
openQuestions.detail: With RTCDiagnosticLogging enabled, start a session with valid metadata (capturing the stamped report), then exceed 5 entries and 100-char values to record Chromium's actual RangeError (or a TypeError if the implementation has aligned with the spec since rtc.cc was checked) — feeding the suite's two limit assertions and confirming the documented divergence is still current.

summary: The deepest page of the set: a realistic bug-report workflow around startDiagnosticLogging options with live spec-limit validation, an honestly-surfaced Chromium/spec exception-type divergence backed by source citation, and truthful absent-API handling. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): honest warn state with disabled start, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow — though the row-remove buttons are under-sized for touch. Open items: chromestatus link, tap-target size, amber contrast, and flagged-build limit verification.
